result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred 12-month software conformance warranty and includes professional/workmanlike services, legal compliance, and no-malicious-code warranties. However, it provides repair, replacement, or refund remedies only for breach of clause (b), not for the services warranty, and it does not establish the required 90-day services warranty period. The reference to refunding fees for “services” is ineffective and ambiguous because the remedy is triggered only by breach of the Licensed Technology warranty. It also unnecessarily narrows the disclaimer to only implied warranties, potentially leaving extra-contractual express warranties undisclaimed. Drafting defects in the retained disclaimer and the mismatch between the remedy trigger and covered fees further reduce quality.
